title: NoteTypeFilters v2 (extension X5)
description: Replaces note_type_filters.schema.json v1. The only substantive change is that `unknown` is no longer a legal value. v1 allowed `high: [unknown]`, which made two different things indistinguishable in the data structure: a determination that succeeded and found no identifiable type, versus a determination that never ran. A pure wiring failure therefore wore the costume of a legitimate conclusion and survived unnoticed for over two months. Fixing the wiring fixes that one instance; fixing the schema is what stops the next wiring bug failing the same silent way.
$comment: HOST: replaces note_type_filters.schema.json. Consumers must migrate: v1 `unknown` -> either null or UNDETERMINABLE, and the two are not interchangeable.

note_type_source.description: Where note types actually came from. NOT_WIRED is the honest value when no source was supplied — v1 had no way to say this, which is precisely how the failure hid.

criterionFilter.description: Per-priority lists of note types. A priority key may be null (not determined) but must never contain the string 'unknown'.

oneOf.description: NOT DETERMINED. The derivation did not run, or could not run. This is a pipeline fault: fix the code.

items.$comment: UNDETERMINABLE is permitted as an explicit member: the determination ran and this document genuinely has no classifiable type. That is a property of the data, not a fault.

informativeness.description: Computed at derivation time. null and UNDETERMINABLE are counted SEPARATELY and never summed: one means fix the code, the other means accept the data or change the source. Merging them reproduces the exact defect this schema exists to prevent.
